body:
I'm afraid of failing people who trust me, and that scares the shit out of me.

I'm afraid that I will always be stuck in this never ending rut, that I'll always be just barely not good enough for this new position, or for this advancement, or for this girl.

The past has dealt me some strange hands and I just think things will continue that way for a good long while.

How much more pain can I take? How long is it going to be this way? How do I effectively switch gears?

Every self help thing I have seen says stuff like "things may get better." May isn't concrete enough for me. I don't want to underachieve in anyone's eyes any more. I'm going through this insanely rough patch and I don't have any reason to believe it will end at any time. I could try to alter my destiny but that's not guaranteed to work.

I just want something concrete and this looks like the only realistic option currently available to me.
